security_audit.summary: Most static findings are scanner collisions involving CSS, Markdown links, template literals, and local rendering operations. Confirmed concerns include unpinned npm bootstrap behavior, environment-influenced module loading, unsanitized HTML insertion, remote assets, and project-root HTTP serving. Static review was capped at 400/833 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 433 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Dependency bootstrap can use @latest or an unrestricted environment override.
remediation.suggestion: Require exact allowlisted versions, reject aliases and alternate sources, and verify package integrity before import.

remediation.issue: Module resolution accepts environment-derived node_modules directories.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve only allowlisted packages from trusted project or bundled locations, then verify the resolved package name and version.

remediation.issue: Generated picker data is inserted through innerHTML without sanitization.
remediation.suggestion: Use textContent and DOM APIs for text fields, then sanitize preview HTML with a strict allowlist before rendering.

remediation.issue: The picker server exposes the project directory on network interfaces.
remediation.suggestion: Serve only the generated picker directory and bind explicitly to 127.0.0.1.

remediation.issue: Preset pages load executable JavaScript and fonts from external CDNs.
remediation.suggestion: Vendor fixed assets locally or add integrity hashes, restrictive Content Security Policy rules, and documented offline behavior.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Dependency Bootstrap
semantic_findings.description: When no bundled version is found, the loader returns @latest and accepts it as pinned. Approved bootstrap can therefore install and import a moving dependency release.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback explicitly returns @latest, while the validation only checks for an at-sign after the package name. The behavior is directly visible in the loader.

semantic_findings.title: Environment-Controlled Package Spec
semantic_findings.description: The version override is concatenated into the npm package spec without semantic-version validation. An alias or alternate package source can replace the intended producer package.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The override is not constrained to a semantic version before it reaches npm. Npm package specifications support aliases and alternate sources.

semantic_findings.title: Environment-Controlled Module Resolution
semantic_findings.description: The loader searches directories supplied through HYPERFRAMES_SKILL_NODE_MODULES and PATH, then dynamically imports the resolved module. A poisoned directory can execute arbitrary package code.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The environment-derived paths are added directly to the resolution bases, and the resulting path is imported as executable JavaScript.

semantic_findings.title: Project Root Exposed by Local HTTP Server
semantic_findings.description: The picker workflow starts Python's HTTP server from the project root without a loopback bind. Other hosts on the reachable network may browse project files.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented command changes into the project directory and starts http.server without --bind 127.0.0.1. Python serves the current directory on available interfaces by default.

high_findings.title: Environment file access
high_findings.confidence_reasoning: The loader forwards the complete process environment to a relaunched process that can import newly installed modules. Secrets in unrelated environment variables become available to that dependency code.

high_findings.title: Synchronous spawn
high_findings.confidence_reasoning: This call runs npm to download packages into a temporary directory. Although lifecycle scripts are disabled and confirmation is requested, imported package code executes later and the version can fall back to @latest.

high_findings.title: Dynamic import() expression
high_findings.confidence_reasoning: The loader executes a module resolved from the current project, PATH-derived directories, or an environment-provided node_modules directory. A poisoned resolution path can therefore cause arbitrary module code execution.

content.value_statement: HyperFrames projects can look inconsistent when visual, narrative, and brand decisions are made separately. This skill coordinates those decisions through focused references, presets, and audit scripts.
actual_capabilities: Interpret frame.md or design.md tokens as brand constraints for video compositions.
Select palettes, typography, composition patterns, and visual style presets.
Plan multi-scene beats, focal points, transitions, depth layers, and rhythm.
Draft narration structure, pacing, number pronunciation, and opening hooks.
Generate an interactive design picker for mood boards and detailed visual choices.
Guide contrast audits and audio-band extraction with included scripts.
limitations: It does not replace hyperframes-core technical rules or hyperframes-animation motion recipes.
Audio extraction requires Python, ffmpeg, and numpy on the local system.
Contrast auditing may install temporary npm dependencies after user confirmation.
Some presets load remote fonts and GSAP unless assets are stored locally.

use_cases.title: Shape a brand launch video
use_cases.description: Translate brand tokens into a coherent palette, type system, frame treatment, and narration direction.

use_cases.title: Plan a product explainer
use_cases.description: Define distinct beats, visual hierarchy, transitions, proof moments, and narration pacing before production.

use_cases.title: Build an audio-reactive edit
use_cases.description: Extract frequency bands and map musical energy to visual intensity, composition changes, and timing.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a visual direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose a visual direction for a 30-second launch video about [product]. Provide one palette, one type pairing, and three composition rules.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin a project without an existing design specification.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a five-beat storyboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-beat storyboard for [audience] using [brand spec]. Include each beat's concept, focal points, narration goal, and transition.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn approved brand guidance into a structured video plan.

prompt_templates.title: Align narration and rhythm
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a 45-second narration and visual rhythm plan for [product]. Keep the script near 110 words and align each section to beats.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate voiceover pacing with scene timing and emphasis.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a finished composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [composition directory] against [frame.md]. Identify design drift, contrast issues, weak hierarchy, repetitive motion, and concrete corrections.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review an advanced composition before final rendering.

output_examples.input: Create a visual direction for a calm financial research video.
output: Use a warm light canvas with one saturated cobalt accent.
Pair a restrained geometric display face with a neutral body face.
Structure each scene around one evidence panel and one explanatory focal point.

output_examples.input: Plan five beats for a developer tool launch.
output: Beat one establishes the problem with a direct visual contrast.
Beats two and three demonstrate the workflow and proof.
Beat five closes with a focused action.

output_examples.input: Review a composition with weak readability.
output_examples.output: The audit identifies low-contrast text, undersized labels, empty backgrounds, repeated entrances, and specific visual corrections for each scene.

best_practices: Read the existing design specification before choosing colors, fonts, spacing, or tone.
Plan scene concepts and narrative rhythm before writing detailed animation instructions.
Run contrast and design-adherence checks before the final render.
anti_patterns: Do not replace approved brand colors with preferred defaults.
Do not add scenes, narration, music, or transitions without clear scope.
Do not use generic palettes, repeated card grids, or identical entrance motion.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces creative direction, design specifications, beat plans, narration guidance, picker options, and audit recommendations.

faq.question: Does it create animation code?
faq.answer: It provides high-level motion guidance. Detailed motion patterns and scene blueprints belong to hyperframes-animation.

faq.question: Can it follow an existing brand system?
faq.answer: Yes. It treats frame.md or design.md frontmatter as the source for colors, typography, spacing, and constraints.

faq.question: Can it help with voiceover?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers narration structure, pacing, hooks, tone, pauses, and number pronunciation for text-to-speech.

faq.question: Which local tools may be required?
faq.answer: Audio analysis requires Python, ffmpeg, and numpy. Contrast auditing uses Node packages and browser rendering.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Some font discovery, preset assets, and temporary package bootstrap steps use external services. Local vendoring can reduce this dependency.
